definitions.explanation: A division of a hospital or clinic organized around a medical specialty, such as internal medicine, pediatrics, or orthopedics. The term appears on hospital directories, signage, and insurance paperwork to direct patients to the appropriate doctor.

examples.japanese: {診療科|しんりょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療科|しんりょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This hospital has twenty medical departments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧{診療科|しんりょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult the medical department that matches your symptoms.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧ ('medical examination and treatment') and {科|か} ('department; section'). The {科|か} element is the same suffix seen in school subject names like ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧ and in other institutional divisions; here it designates the medical specialty each department covers.

USAGE:
- When patients make an appointment or visit reception, they are usually asked which {診療科|しんりょうか} they wish to see.
- Hospital websites list available departments under a {診療科|しんりょうか}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧ ('list of departments') menu.
- ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧{診療科|しんりょうか} ('general medicine department') exists at larger hospitals for patients who are unsure which specialty fits their symptoms.

COMMON DEPARTMENTS:
- ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧: internal medicine
- ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧: surgery
- ⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧: pediatrics
- ⟦{産婦人科|さんふじんか}→産婦人科：16784_sanfujinka⟧: obstetrics and gynecology
- ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧: ophthalmology
- ⟦{耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}→耳鼻咽喉科：23659_jibiinkouka⟧: otolaryngology (ENT)
- ⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧: orthopedics
- ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧: dermatology
- ⟦{精神科|せいしんか}→精神科：21587_seishinka⟧: psychiatry

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {診療科|しんりょうか}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of departments
- {診療科|しんりょうか}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: by department
- {診療科|しんりょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to consult a department
- ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療科|しんりょうか}: the relevant department

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {科|か}: department; field — used as a suffix (e.g., ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧), rarely standing alone in the medical sense.
- ⟦{病棟|びょうとう}→病棟：21002_byoutou⟧: hospital ward — a physical ward within a hospital, not a clinical specialty.
- {専門医|せんもんい}: specialist doctor — a doctor certified in a specific {診療科|しんりょうか}.
